alignment.state: One complex field + activity trace + antisymmetric fast coupling, no separate expert outputs
alignment.linear_initialization: Same train-fitted LR coefficients for all NNs; linear skip remains trainable
alignment.readout: Nonlinear state decoder; no PCA and no raw-input MLP bypass in the field
alignment.data: Same v16 five-role PSU splits; all4 years; previously inspected data remains exploratory
alignment.uncertainty: 2000 paired full-frame PSU resamples, fixed trained predictions; no full training uncertainty

alignment.history: All models receive the same64 observed values; GRU uses attention over all window states
alignment.initialization: Same train-fitted Ridge linear skip, trainable throughout; four linear delay targets are largely solved at initialization, so they do not prove intrinsic recurrent memory
alignment.decoder: Field nonlinear correction can use only shared cell state; no PCA; no direct raw-input nonlinear bypass
alignment.uncertainty: 2000 paired resamples of20 whole held-out streams, fixed trained models
alignment.scope: Newly generated synthetic test streams; no clinical forecasting claim

cost.protocol: Resident encoded input and model forward only; inference_mode; 8 warmups then 40 timed repetitions; CUDA synchronized before and after each call. Excludes preprocessing, transfer, calibration and JSON. Selected seed42 weights; no retraining. Training times include validation and diagnostics; tuning sums include all candidate fits, not data setup.
